title: Folder preview leaks over windows and virtual desktops after switching virtual desktops
line: Folder previews no longer pop up over the windows of another virtual desktop when you switch desktops while hovering a folder.
explanation: A folder in a Folder View widget (or inside a preview) opens its preview after a hover delay. Switching virtual desktop with the keyboard doesn't make the folder lose hover right away, so the timer still fired and the preview window opened on the new desktop, on top of its windows; an already open preview also stayed open. The change listens for virtual desktop changes in every folder view, stops the pending hover timer and closes the open preview.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: close folder previews on virtual desktop change

Hovering a folder and switching virtual desktop just before its preview
opened made the preview show up over the windows of the new desktop. Stop
the pending hover timer and close open previews when the desktop changes.

BUG: 508125

review.text: Listening to `TaskManager.VirtualDesktopInfo.onCurrentDesktopChanged` in `FolderView.qml` to stop `hoverActivateTimer` and close any open popup via `main.hoveredItem?.closePopup()` directly fixes folder previews leaking onto another virtual desktop. The change is concise, handles both pending hover timers and already-open (including nested) previews, and leaving out the separate KWin focus-activation switch cancellation avoids regressing keyboard navigation and close-on-deactivate in previews.

reviews.text: Listening to `TaskManager.VirtualDesktopInfo.onCurrentDesktopChanged` in `FolderView.qml` to stop `hoverActivateTimer` and close any open popup via `main.hoveredItem?.closePopup()` directly fixes folder previews leaking onto another virtual desktop. The change is concise, handles both pending hover timers and already-open (including nested) previews, and leaving out the separate KWin focus-activation switch cancellation avoids regressing keyboard navigation and close-on-deactivate in previews.

Fixes the reported leak (hover timer firing after a keyboard desktop switch, preview opening over the new desktop's windows) with a small, targeted change in FolderView.qml: stop hoverActivateTimer and close the hovered item's popup on VirtualDesktopInfo.currentDesktopChanged. Using org.kde.taskmanager from the desktop containment is a new import but plasma-desktop already depends on libtaskmanager, and VirtualDesktopInfo shares one backend, so the per-FolderView instances are cheap. Evidence (6/14 leaks before, 0/35 after) and the commit message match the diff. The reporter's separate c5 complaint (the preview stealing focus and cancelling the switch) is honestly noted as still present; it can be tracked on its own.
